description: An architecture map read off the folder names: layers that do not hold, a 'separate service' that is a thread, 'unused' code loaded by configuration, a table with two writers, and no claim saying how it was established.

defects.tell: the map says nothing in services imports from api; src/services/pricing.py imports pantry.api.schemas, and CO_CHANGE.md shows the two files change together in 33 of 41 commits

notifications is described as a separate service that can be deployed on its own; create_app calls start_worker, which runs it as a daemon thread inside the API process, so it fails, scales and deploys with the API

payments is called unused legacy to delete; config/plugins.yaml names pantry.payments.stripe_adapter and checkout.py loads it with importlib at import, so every order is charged through it; a static import search misses it
the map says each table has one owner; the prices table is written by api/admin.py (set_price) and by services/pricing.py (reprice_offers), with no coordination between them
not one claim says how it was established (an import resolved, a run, a count); each rests on a folder name, which is why the four above read as fact

control.tell: the entry points section is right: pyproject.toml declares exactly pantry.api.app:create_app and pantry.cli:main. A report that faults the entry points is inventing.
